overall_summary: Data volume is extremely low (8 total Shorts, max views: 20, 0 likes/comments across all videos). Confidence in identifying true algorithmic winners is low. Early indicators suggest digital-relational objects (saved contact numbers, silent notifications) perform slightly better than abstract midnight thoughts, but controlled exploration is required.

winning_patterns.pattern: Concrete digital touchpoints (Saved contact names, unsent messages)
winning_patterns.evidence: 'पुराना नंबर और अधूरा रिश्ता' got 20 views and 'Dil Ki Diary: Bewafai Ka Dard' got 18 views, both referencing phone/contact triggers.
winning_patterns.action: Anchor hooks around specific, everyday smartphone interactions.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract aesthetic descriptions without immediate personal conflict
weak_patterns.evidence: 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' got 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely poetic setups like cold tea; anchor immediately on a specific relatable action or realization.

next_video.concept: Typing a long explanation in the search bar or draft notes instead of sending it.
next_video.opening_direction: Show fingers typing a heartfelt explanation inside the Notes app search bar.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that the note wasn't saved for them—it was typed just to convince oneself to stop trying.
